D32O_TP_URBAN_CRACKED.en: [grim] Master Urban's great gun is silent today: two cracks in the bronze. [pointed] Some impatient lad's doing, they say. This is its little brother; the load falls on it now.

D32O_TP_URBAN_TAPED.en: [amused] Master Urban's great gun is talking at the next battery, still with your grey strip round its waist. [fond] This is its little brother; it talks less and listens more.

D32O_T_25_BAD.en: [sheepish] Miss the last five minutes of a meeting and you miss the whole project. [sighs] Same in insurance.

D32O_T_25_OK.en: [innocent] I heard nothing, Head Cook. [lowered voice] All I know is: fasting today, the assault tomorrow.

D36_G_01.en: [lowered voice] [commanding] The Turks are digging a trench fifty paces beyond the moat. They've set wheeled wooden screens in front of it. [determined] Before first light we burn the screens and scatter the diggers.

D36_G_02.en: [whispers] [firm] Cross on the planks, not a sound. If the drums start, drop whatever you're holding and run back. [grave] No one stays outside.

D36_G_ALL.en: [relieved] [solemn] Everyone who went out came back. [softly] Tonight God counted the Genoese one by one.

D36_G_BACK.en: [shouting] [urgent] Back! Everyone to the bridge! The men on the wall will cover you!

D36_G_BURN.en: [urgent] The diggers have run. Take the torch and set all three screens alight. [shouting] Quickly!

D36_G_LEON.en: [grief-stricken] [quietly] The sipahis took Leon. I couldn't hold the gate open for him; [bitter] if I had, they'd have taken us all.

D36_G_ORDER.en: [grave] Orders from the Emperor: from now on no one goes outside the walls. [heavy] Losing one of our men costs more than costing them a thousand.

D36_L_01.en: [friendly] [confident] I'm Leon, archer. On the way back I'll watch your back, interpreter. Don't worry.

D36_L_HELP.en: [in pain] [shouting] Interpreter! My leg... an arrow! [desperate] I can't get up!

D36_L_THANKS.en: [grateful] [out of breath] I owe you, interpreter. Leon doesn't forget a debt.

D36_L_UP.en: [groaning] Your shoulder... all right. [gritted teeth] Walk, I'll keep up.

D36_N_01.en: [over a crackling radio] [formal] 9 April 1453, before dawn. The siege has barely begun; the great gun has not fired yet. According to the file, tonight Giustiniani's men go out beyond the walls. [firm] Mr Tolga, you go with them. Observation only.

D36_N_END.en: [formal] Recorded. 9 April: the sortie. [grave] From now on the Greeks fight only from inside the walls.

D36_N_PHOTO.en: [over a crackling radio] [urgent] Record frame, Mr Tolga: the burning screens, the walls behind. Be quick, the camp is waking.

D36_T_01.en: [nervous] [sarcastic] So we're leaving these lovely stone walls of our own free will. Fine. [nervous laugh] Normally I'm the type who locks the door from the inside.

D36_T_BURN_2.en: [excited] [whispers] Two. Dry wood, pitch-soaked cloth... it goes up nicely.

D36_T_LEON.en: [guilty] [quietly] I walked right past him. I know.

D36_T_TORCH.en: [awed] [nervous laugh] A torch. I am holding an actual torch. [anxious] I wonder if this is insured.

D38O_R_01_TOLD.en: [urgent] [remorseful] Clerk! The eyes before the chain! That night you said "their turbans are wound wrong"; I didn't listen, and twenty days later we missed by an oar's length. [earnest] Tonight, whatever you see, tell me. I'll listen.

D38O_S2_HOOKS_AGAIN.en: [exasperated] Just like the hooks... [relieved] Never mind, both of them are up.

D38O_S2_HOOKS_BAD.en: [resentful] Clerk, on 20 April I was on Baltaoğlu's galley too. Your hooks didn't hold; the next day they dismissed the Bey. [stern] The ladder's yours. Make it hold this time.

D38O_S2_HOOKS_EVEN.en: [grudging respect] It held. I've forgotten the hooks, clerk.

D38O_S2_HOOKS_OK.en: [warm] Clerk, on 20 April I was on Baltaoğlu's galley too. You were the only oarsman whose hook held that day. [eager] I'll take the ladder's other leg; two hands beat one.

D39O_SA_38_BAD.en: [hostile] I know you, clerk. When I fell in the water at the Golden Horn you were on the quay writing on your paper; the old man pulled me out. [defiant] Your paper won't stop me today either.

D39O_SA_38_MID.en: [grudging] You pulled me out of the water, clerk, I'll give you that. But that night the ladder didn't hold and the job was left half done. [stubborn] Step aside; I know this door as well as you.

D39O_SA_38_OK.en: [hesitant] Wait... that face. You're the clerk who pulled me out from between the quay and the hull at the Golden Horn walls. [sighs] ...Fine. I won't swing. [firm] But you stop my mate.

D39O_SA_TEZ_SULTAN.en: [stunned] The clerk's name on the Sultan's own paper? [reverent] ...Axes down. We'll wait a while longer.

D39O_TW_PASS.en: [amazed] This seal... it's Theodoros the Logothete's! The seven-copies man. [relieved] Anyone who got a permit out of him is honest. [eager] Wait, I'll run and fetch the çavuş myself!

D39O_T_38_BAD.en: [earnest] That day fell short, I know. [determined] This door won't fall short today.

D39O_T_38_OK.en: [warm] Wet, but alive. [pleading] Let the people behind this door stay alive too; that's all.

D39O_T_TEZ_SULTAN.en: [confident] And this one's mine. Not Davud's: the Sultan's own tughra, with my name under it. [reading aloud] "Let no one bar the way of the bearer."

D14_M_SICIL.en: [businesslike] The witness's Damage Assessment File came in too, Mr Nihat. The record summary is on the first page. [pointed] Upstairs will read that too.

D14_N_SICIL_31O_1.en: [quietly] [moved] One more line: the three days after the conquest. A child out of a burning house, a grave at Eyüp, rows in Hagia Sophia. [warmly] I'm writing: 'The witness kept working after the ruin.'

D14_N_SICIL_31O_2.en: [dry] One more line: the three days after the conquest. The witness was late for most of it; others got there. [sighs] I'm writing: 'Tired.' [gently] It isn't a lie.

D14_N_SICIL_BAD.en: [weary] Stained. But every page has a photograph. [firm] A bad witness is still a witness, Mrs Müfide. Better than no witness at all.

D14_N_SICIL_GOOD.en: [pleased] Clean. Can an insurance salesman make a witness? Apparently so. [dry] On forms we call that 'unexpected competence'.

D14_N_SICIL_MID.en: [thoughtful] Half of it good, half of it history. On forms that's called 'average'. [warmly] I call it 'human'.

D14_N_Z1_SEEN.en: [wistful] Form Z-1. The signature I say good morning to every day: 'T.' I've wondered who it was for forty years. [soft laugh] I said good morning this morning too; still no answer.

D15_O_CARD.en: [confused] [excited] Tolga, a museum in Sinop called. Your business card turned up inside a manuscript. They say the ink is five hundred years old. [suspicious] Is this a joke?

D15_O_CARD_T.en: [nervous laugh] Life, motor, home... [sheepish] I did say I'd come out to Sinop.

D16_HU_GONE_HUCUBE.en: [confused] The chicken's gone too. And the Frank. I've still got the cube, though. [long pause] [whispers] We're not telling anyone about this.

D16_HU_GONE_HUFEZ.en: [confused] The chicken's gone too. And the Frank. The fez is still here, though. [long pause] [whispers] We're not telling anyone about this.

D16_H_GONE_HUFEZ.en: [bewildered] ...Fez. Where did the Frank on our shoulders go?

D12_F_TEZKIRE.en: [commanding] [warm] One more thing. This warrant goes with you. There's no one in the camp who doesn't know my tughra; [firm] if anyone blocks your way, show it.

D12_F_TEZKIRE_HIKMET.en: [commanding] One more thing. This warrant goes with you. [amused] I'd have one written for the old man too, but a nightgown has no pockets.

D12_T_TEZKIRE.en: [awed] A paper with a tughra. In insurance we'd call this a letter of guarantee. [reverent] I've never seen one this beautiful.

D10B_U_FUSE_ULIGHTER.en: [urgent] The fuse! You light it, apprentice. [teasing] Your fire box is with me, though; you've only got the torch.

D10B_U_FUSE_URBAN_ULIGHTER.en: [scornful] Coward apprentice! [proud] Look, this is how it's done.

D10H_TH_PASS.en: [surprised] [delighted] That's my seal! The feast-day permit... you got it back from the gull. [warm] A man who carries my seal doesn't mistranslate. I'll tell the Emperor so.

D10O_A_FEZ_VOUCH.en: [skeptical] If Hüseyin vouches... are you Hüseyin? You've got the fez. [shrugs] Very well. Surety accepted.

D10O_A_Q1_SKIP_FEZ.en: [dry] Hüseyin answered question one. I knew him by the fez. [brisk] On to question two.

D10O_G_LIFT2_HUCUBE.en: [confident] I'm Hasan. [confused] I'm not. [gentle] Gently. Up we go.

D10O_G_LIFT2_HUFEZ.en: [proud] I'm Hüseyin. The fez. [gentle] Gently. Up we go.

D10O_HU_FEZ_VOUCH.en: [eager] [shouting] Agha! We know this one. He gave me his spare fez. His name's Tolga. [proud] Hasan's my witness.

D10O_T_THROWN_2_HUFEZ.en: [groaning] My second carrying. [wry] The one in the fez is Hüseyin. I'd know my own fez anywhere.

D10Z_K_STOVE_KTHERMOS.en: [instructive] Now the stove. Set the fire for each pot. Too little: raw. Too much: charcoal. In between: the Sultan. [pleased] Your magic jug is here too; still hot since yesterday.

D10Z_K_THERMOS_SAVE.en: [panicked] [shouting] The magic jug! It didn't burn! [relieved] [out of breath] ...It's raw, but it didn't burn.

D9_G_2_HUFEZ.en: [proud] Honour... it's this red kaftan. I'm Hüseyin, by the way. The one in the fez. Definitely. [curious] Are you here to go before the Sultan?

D9_G_LATER_HUFEZ.en: [casual] Come back later. The gate's not going anywhere. Neither are we. [pleased] And now we know who's who: the fez is Hüseyin.

D9_HA_CUBE_BACK.en: [weary] [amused] He's been dreaming of coloured squares for three nights. [sighs] Now I am too.

D9_HA_THERMOS_BACK.en: [sheepish] Here, your magic jug. We said a five-minute break; [chuckles] it lasted three days.

D9_HU_CUBE_BACK.en: [proud] Here's your box. I did one side. [sighs] The rest is in God's hands.

D9_HU_THERMOS_BACK.en: [earnest] We left you one cup. For you. Hüseyin wanted to drink it, Hasan wouldn't let him. [confused] Or the other way round.

D9_HU_THERMOS_BACK_HUFEZ.en: [earnest] We left you one cup. Hasan wanted to drink it, I wouldn't let him. [proud] I'm Hüseyin, the one in the fez; we know that now.

D9_T_CUBE_BACK.en: [impressed] One side done. [self-deprecating] The side I've never managed in years.

D9_T_CUBE_KEEP.en: [warm] No room in the bag. Keep it, Hüseyin. [encouraging] Solve the rest too.

D9_T_THERMOS_BACK.en: [touched] The thermos is back. One cup of tea inside, [warmly] and the honesty of two janissaries.

D9_T_THERMOS_KEEP.en: [warm] No room in the bag. You keep it; the watch is long.

D8_A1_KNOWN.en: [flat] [robotic] The garage uncle! Caught in our spotlight three times last night. [suspicious] I've got my eye on you.

D7_HASAN_FAN_HUFEZ.en: [nervous] [too quickly] Fez... frock coat... No. Never seen him.

D7_HUSEYIN_FAN_HUFEZ.en: [nervous] [innocent] What's a fez? No idea. Never seen one.

D7_HUSEYIN_HELLO_HUFEZ.en: [cheerful] I'm Hüseyin. The one in the fez. [proud] Look: fez. [curious] Who are you?

D7_HUSEYIN_WHO_HUCUBE.en: [distracted] Which of us said it? Doesn't matter. [concentrating] One more side. Nearly there.

D7_HUSEYIN_WHO_HUFEZ.en: [proud] Which of us said it? I did. The one in the fez. [pleased] We know that now.

D7_URBAN_DJINN_LIGHTER_ULIGHTER.en: [excited] The pocket fire! My apprentice's! Look, I've got it. [proud] Lights first time. [chuckles] My apprentice is at the foundry now. Eyebrows singed.

D6B_G_BOOK_BACK.en: [proud] [firm] Take your book. A Genoese doesn't read his future; he writes it.

D6B_G_BOOK_KEEP.en: [thoughtful] Leave it. I'll read it tonight. If my name is in it, I want to know what it says. [uneasy] ...Even if I'd rather not.

D6B_T_BOOK_KEEP.en: [nervous laugh] I left my high-school history book with Giustiniani. My teacher would be proud. [wincing] Or have a heart attack.

D6_URBAN_LIGHTER_2.en: [pleased] I'll keep this, apprentice. A fuse box. [generous] In return I'll have your name put down at the foundry.

D4A_HA_FEZ_2.en: [solemn] [teasing] You'd be Hüseyin. For certain. For life.

D4A_HA_WET.en: [matter-of-fact] Spies don't get wet, Hüseyin. Spies stay dry. [confident] This one's a fisherman for sure.

D4A_HU_FEZ_1.en: [amazed] A red cap! [excited] Hasan, if I wear this... nobody will ever mix us up again!

D4A_HU_FEZ_3.en: [proud] I'm Hüseyin. The one in the fez. [conspiratorial] Go on, my fezzed friend. We didn't see you. [giggles] Fez Hüseyin didn't either.

D4A_HU_WET.en: [curious] Why's he wet, Hasan? [worried] Did he fall off the chain?

D4A_T_01_WET.en: [dazed] [shivering] I'm in a tent. The sign on it says 'Frankish spy'. The Golden Horn is still dripping off my trousers. [desperate] I sell insurance.

D4A_T_FEZ.en: [wry] A gift from the Golden Horn. My spare.

D4A_T_WIN_FEZ.en: [proud] I solved twenty-five years of identity crisis with a single fez. [smug] In insurance we call that risk transfer.

CL_BARK_BREAD.tr: [shouting] [cheerful] Ekmek, sıcak ekmek! [proudly] Kuşatmada bile fırın yanıyor!
CL_BARK_BREAD.en: [shouting] [cheerful] Bread, warm bread! [proudly] The ovens burn even in a siege!

CL_BARK_CLOTH.tr: [shouting] [salesman voice] Bursa ipeği, Venedik çuhası, gel bak!
CL_BARK_CLOTH.en: [shouting] [salesman voice] Bursa silk, Venetian wool, come and look!

CL_BARK_CURFEW.tr: [stern] Gece sokakta dolaşılmaz. [firm] Evine git, kapını sürgüle.
CL_BARK_CURFEW.en: [stern] No wandering the streets at night. [firm] Go home and bar your door.

CL_BARK_FISH.en: [shouting] [cheerful] Fresh mackerel! Straight out of the Golden Horn!

CL_BARK_FRUIT.en: [shouting] [cheerful] Plums, cherries, fresh from the garden!

CL_BARK_HALT.en: [commanding] [suspicious] Halt! Who are you, where are you going?

CL_BARK_J_MOVE.en: [shouting] [commanding] Clear the way, patrol coming through!

CL_BARK_J_QUARTER.tr: [firm] Bu mahalle Sultan'ın himayesinde. [impatient] Yürü, oyalanma.
CL_BARK_J_QUARTER.en: [firm] This quarter is under the Sultan's protection. [impatient] Move along.

CL_BARK_POTS.tr: [shouting] [salesman voice] Çömlek, testi! Su taşımaya bundan iyisi yok!
CL_BARK_POTS.en: [shouting] [salesman voice] Pots and jugs! Nothing better for carrying water!

CL_BARK_WALLS.tr: [impatient] [shouting] Surlarda taş taşıyacak el lazım, boş durma!
CL_BARK_WALLS.en: [impatient] [shouting] The walls need hands to haul stone. Don't stand idle!

D_ARENA_N_B.tr: [over a crackling radio] [formal] Tolga Bey, bu kayıt Büro'nun tatbikatıdır. Tarihe sayılmaz. [dry] Gediği tutabildiğiniz kadar tutun.
D_ARENA_N_B.en: [over a crackling radio] [formal] "Mr Tolga, this entry is a Bureau drill. It doesn't count towards history. [dry] Hold the breach as long as you can."

D_ARENA_N_O.tr: [over a crackling radio] [formal] Tolga Bey, bu kayıt Büro'nun tatbikatıdır. Tarihe sayılmaz. [dry] Yamaçta durabildiğiniz kadar durun.
D_ARENA_N_O.en: [over a crackling radio] [formal] "Mr Tolga, this entry is a Bureau drill. It doesn't count towards history. [dry] Hold the slope as long as you can."

D_CLIMB_FALL_1.tr: [pained] Ay! [groaning] Kalktım, kalktım. [embarrassed] Bir şey yok.
D_CLIMB_FALL_1.en: [pained] Ow! [groaning] I'm up, I'm up. [embarrassed] Nothing broken.

D_CLIMB_FALL_3.en: [pained] [indignant] That fall was not in the policy.

D_CLIMB_LEAP.tr: [straining] Hop! [out of breath] ...Bunu bir daha yapmayacağım. [nervous laugh] Muhtemelen yapacağım.
D_CLIMB_LEAP.en: [straining] Hup! [out of breath] ...I'm never doing that again. [nervous laugh] I'll probably do it again.

D_CLIMB_TIRED_1.tr: [out of breath] [panting] Nefes... nefesim... [whining] Pilates'e yazılacaktım.
D_CLIMB_TIRED_1.en: [out of breath] [panting] Breath... my breath... [whining] I was going to sign up for Pilates.

D_CLIMB_TIRED_2.tr: [out of breath] [complaining] Bu duvar poliçede yoktu.
D_CLIMB_TIRED_2.en: [out of breath] [complaining] This wall wasn't in the policy.

D_CLIMB_TIRED_3.tr: [straining] [whining] Kollarım kalem tutmak için yapılmış, duvar için değil.
D_CLIMB_TIRED_3.en: [straining] [whining] My arms were built for holding pens, not walls.

D_FORM_1.tr: [satisfied] [dry] Bir form daha. Rüzgâr da bürokrasiye karşı.
D_FORM_1.en: [satisfied] [dry] Another form. Even the wind is against bureaucracy.

D_FORM_2.tr: [inspecting] İmzası yerinde. [approving] Mührü ıslak ama geçerli.
D_FORM_2.en: [inspecting] Signature intact. [approving] The seal's damp but valid.

D_FORM_3.tr: [deadpan] Bu formu bir martı okuyordu. [dry] Onay vermiş gibi.
D_FORM_3.en: [deadpan] A seagull was reading this one. [dry] Looks like it approved.

D_FORM_4.en: [thoughtful] Forms always flee to high places. [dry] The nature of bureaucracy.

D_FORM_ALL.tr: [satisfied] [proudly] On iki form, eksiksiz. [dry] Rapora 'uçuş sırasında evrak kaybı yaşanmamıştır' yazabilirim.
D_FORM_ALL.en: [satisfied] [proudly] All twelve forms. [dry] I can now write 'no paperwork was lost during flight' in the report.

D_LM_AYASOFYA.tr: [awed] [softly] Ayasofya. Dokuz yüz yıllık kubbe, yukarıdan bakınca bile insanı susturuyor. [dry] Büro'da buna 'yapısal risk' diyorlar. [deadpan] Bence Büro'nun kendisi yapısal risk.
D_LM_AYASOFYA.en: [awed] [softly] Hagia Sophia. [dry] A nine-hundred-year-old dome, and it silences you even from above. The Bureau calls it a 'structural risk'. [deadpan] I'd say the Bureau is the structural risk.

D_LM_BLAKHERNA.tr: [thoughtful] Blakherna Sarayı. İmparator buradan ordugâhı seyrediyor. Ben de şimdi ikisini birden seyrediyorum. [dry] Yetki alanım genişledi.
D_LM_BLAKHERNA.en: [thoughtful] Blachernae Palace. The emperor watches the camp from here. [dry] And I'm watching both of them. My jurisdiction just expanded.

D_LM_BOZDOGAN.tr: [impressed] Bozdoğan Kemeri. Roma şehre su getirmiş, bin yıldır dayanıyor. [sighs] Bizim Büro'daki musluk üç haftadır damlatıyor.
D_LM_BOZDOGAN.en: [impressed] The Aqueduct of Valens. Rome brought water to the city and it's held for a thousand years. [sighs] The tap at our Bureau has been dripping for three weeks.

D_LM_GALATA.tr: [matter-of-fact] Galata Kulesi. Cenevizlilerin; burada adı İsa Kulesi. Altı yüz yıl sonra önünde fotoğraf kuyruğu olacak. [dry] Şimdilik sadece martılar var.
D_LM_GALATA.en: [matter-of-fact] Galata Tower. The Genoese built it; here they call it the Tower of Christ. [dry] In six hundred years there'll be a queue for photos. For now, just seagulls.

D_LM_HAVARIYUN.tr: [solemn] Havariyun Kilisesi. İmparatorlar burada yatıyor. Birkaç yıl sonra yerinde başka bir yapı yükselecek. [dry] Spoiler vermeyeceğim. [pause] [sighs] Verdim.
D_LM_HAVARIYUN.en: [solemn] The Church of the Holy Apostles. The emperors are buried here. [dry] In a few years another building will rise in its place. [pause] [sighs] No spoilers. Oops.

D_LM_HIPODROM.tr: [thoughtful] Hipodrom. Dikilitaş, Yılanlı Sütun... Araba yarışları bitmiş, taraftarlık kalmış. Maviler, Yeşiller. [dry] Nedense tanıdık geldi.
D_LM_HIPODROM.en: [thoughtful] The Hippodrome. The obelisk, the Serpent Column... [dry] The chariot races are long gone, but the fans stayed. Blues, Greens. Oddly familiar.

D_LM_KONSTANTIN.tr: [matter-of-fact] Konstantin Sütunu. Tepesinde eskiden heykel varmış; 1106'da rüzgâr devirmiş. [deadpan] Büro'da buna 'dosya kapandı' deriz.
D_LM_KONSTANTIN.en: [matter-of-fact] The Column of Constantine. There used to be a statue on top; the wind knocked it down in 1106. [deadpan] At the Bureau we call that 'case closed'.

D_LM_SURLAR.tr: [impressed] Theodosius surları. Bin yıldır kimse aşamamış. [smug] Ben aştım. [dry] Sayılmaz, uçuyorum.
D_LM_SURLAR.en: [impressed] The Theodosian Walls. [smug] No one has breached them in a thousand years. I just did. [dry] Doesn't count, I'm flying.

D_LM_ZINCIR.tr: [thoughtful] Haliç'in zinciri. Kütüklerin üstünde demir halkalar. [grave] Yakında gemiler karadan yürüyecek; zincir buna hazır değil. [quietly] Kimse değil.
D_LM_ZINCIR.en: [thoughtful] The Golden Horn chain. [grave] Iron links on floating logs. Soon ships will walk overland; the chain isn't ready for that. [quietly] Nobody is.

D_NIHAT_CLOAK_EMPTY.tr: [dry] Perde şarjda. [formal] Görünmezlik de bir kaynak, israf edilmez.
D_NIHAT_CLOAK_EMPTY.en: [dry] The veil is recharging. Invisibility is a resource. [formal] It is not to be wasted.

D_NIHAT_CLOAK_OUT.en: [flat] The veil has run out. I'm visible. [sighs] Regrettably.

D_NIHAT_CLOAK_TALK.tr: [dry] Görünmezken sorgu olmaz. [deadpan] Karşıdaki boşlukla konuşuyor sanır.
D_NIHAT_CLOAK_TALK.en: [dry] No questioning while invisible. [deadpan] They'd think they were talking to thin air.

D_NIHAT_EDGE.tr: [formal] Saha kapısının menzili burada bitiyor. [dry] Ötesi başka bir dosyanın konusu.
D_NIHAT_EDGE.en: [formal] The field door's range ends here. [dry] Beyond is another file's business.

D_NIHAT_EXPLORE.tr: [reading aloud] Rıza Bey'in notu: 'İlk uçuşta on iki Z-9 formu kayboldu. Bulursan getir.' [curious] O altın ışıklar... formlar mı?
D_NIHAT_EXPLORE.en: [reading aloud] A note from Rıza Bey: 'Twelve Z-9 forms went missing on the first flight. Bring them back if you find them.' Those golden lights... [curious] are those the forms?

D_NIHAT_LEGEND.tr: [sighs] [resigned] Beş tanık. Bu artık bir efsane. [dry] Efsaneler form doldurmaz, ama kroniklere girer.
D_NIHAT_LEGEND.en: [sighs] [resigned] Five witnesses. That's a legend now. [dry] Legends don't fill in forms, but they do end up in the chronicles.

D_NIHAT_SEEN_1.tr: [alarmed] Görüldüm. [reciting] Madde 1: denetçi görülmez. Madde 1'i ihlal ettim. [worried] Büro Baskısı arttı.
D_NIHAT_SEEN_1.en: [alarmed] I've been seen. [reciting] Article 1: an inspector is never seen. I've breached Article 1. [worried] Bureau pressure has gone up.

D_NIHAT_SEYYAH.tr: [satisfied] Dokuzda dokuz. Evliya Çelebi doğmadan seyahatnameyi bitirdim. [dry] Telif hakkı Büro'nun, tabii.
D_NIHAT_SEYYAH.en: [satisfied] Nine out of nine. I've finished the travelogue before Evliya Çelebi was even born. [dry] Copyright belongs to the Bureau, naturally.

D_NIHAT_VIEW.tr: [thoughtful] Yukarıdan bakınca her şey bir dosya gibi: düzenli görünür, [dry] dağınıktır.
D_NIHAT_VIEW.en: [thoughtful] [dry] From up here everything looks like a file: tidy from a distance, a mess up close.

D_NIHAT_VIEW_11.tr: [softly] [thoughtful] Gece ordugâhı yukarıdan: binlerce ateş. Hepsi yarın için. [concerned] Tolga bunlardan birinin başında.
D_NIHAT_VIEW_11.en: [softly] [thoughtful] The camp at night from above: thousands of fires. All for tomorrow. [concerned] Tolga is sitting by one of them.

D_NIHAT_VIEW_3.tr: [dry] Büro'nun tavanı. Zaman dışında bile tavan var. [deadpan] Yönetmelik.
D_NIHAT_VIEW_3.en: [dry] The Bureau's ceiling. Even outside of time there's a ceiling. [deadpan] Regulations.

D_NIHAT_WATER.tr: [annoyed] Formlar suya dayanıklı değil. Donanım beni kendiliğinden kaldırdı. [prim] Yönetmelik: denetçi ıslanmaz.
D_NIHAT_WATER.en: [annoyed] The forms aren't waterproof. The kit lifted me up on its own. [prim] Regulation: auditors do not get wet.

D_PERCH_AYA.tr: [awed] [softly] Kubbenin tepesindeyim. Dokuz yüz yıllık kurşun, altımda ılık. [whispers] Bir dakika... sadece bakıyorum.
D_PERCH_AYA.en: [awed] [softly] I'm on top of the dome. Nine-hundred-year-old lead, warm under my feet. [whispers] One minute... I'm just looking.

D_PERCH_COLUMN.tr: [smug] [dry] Konstantin'in sütunu. Heykelin yerinde şimdi bir denetçi var. Tarih kendini düzeltir.
D_PERCH_COLUMN.en: [smug] [dry] Constantine's column. Where the statue stood, now there's an auditor. History corrects itself.

D_PERCH_GALATA.tr: [calm] [content] Galata'nın galerisi. Cenevizli nöbetçi yok, ben varım. [softly] Haliç bir kâğıt gibi serili.
D_PERCH_GALATA.en: [calm] [content] Galata's gallery. No Genoese sentry, just me. [softly] The Golden Horn laid out like a sheet of paper.

D_WIT_1.en: [terrified] [shouting] A djinn! A djinn in a fedora!

D_WIT_10.en: [shocked] [shouting] Good Lord! The tax collector can fly!

D_WIT_2.tr: [awed] [confused] Melek mi o? Neden şapkası var?
D_WIT_2.en: [awed] [confused] Is that an angel? Why is it wearing a hat?

D_WIT_3.tr: [whispers] [scared] Hasan, gördün mü? [pause] [firmly] ...Görmedim. Sen de görmedin.
D_WIT_3.en: [whispers] [scared] Hasan, did you see that? ...I didn't. [pause] [firmly] And neither did you.

D_WIT_4.tr: [amazed] [shouting] Uçan bir Frenk! [laughing nervously] Kimse inanmayacak!
D_WIT_4.en: [amazed] [shouting] A flying Frank! [laughing nervously] No one's going to believe this!

D_WIT_5.tr: [stunned] Evliya Çelebi bunu yazsa kimse inanmazdı.
D_WIT_5.en: [stunned] If a chronicler wrote this down, nobody would believe it.

D_WIT_8.tr: [nervous] [whispers] Kimse bir şey demesin. Sadece yüzüne bakmayın.
D_WIT_8.en: [nervous] [whispers] Nobody say anything. Just don't look at its face.

D_WIT_9.tr: [stammering] O... o bir kuş değil. [baffled] Kuşlar kravat takmaz.
D_WIT_9.en: [stammering] That... that's not a bird. [baffled] Birds don't wear ties.

REACT_CROWD_BYZ_ANY.tr: [amazed] Konstantinopolis'te her şeyi gördüm sanıyordum. [chuckles] Bunu görmemiştim.
REACT_CROWD_BYZ_ANY.en: [amazed] I thought I'd seen everything in Constantinople. [chuckles] I hadn't seen that.

REACT_CROWD_BYZ_CHICKPEAS.tr: [excited] Leblebi! Kuşatmada leblebi altın değerinde. [pleading] Bir avuç ver, senin için dua ederim.
REACT_CROWD_BYZ_CHICKPEAS.en: [excited] Roasted chickpeas! In a siege they're worth gold. [pleading] Give me a handful and I'll pray for you.

REACT_CROWD_BYZ_COLOGNE.tr: [sniffs] [nostalgic] Limon kokusu! Rahmetli karım gibi kokuyorsun. [warmly] İyi bir şey bu, merak etme.
REACT_CROWD_BYZ_COLOGNE.en: [sniffs] [nostalgic] Lemon! You smell like my late wife. [warmly] That's a good thing, don't worry.

REACT_CROWD_BYZ_CUBE.tr: [curious] Renkli kutu mu? [chuckles] Benim oğlan bunu çevirir durur, şehir düşse fark etmez.
REACT_CROWD_BYZ_CUBE.en: [curious] A coloured box? [chuckles] My boy would turn this all day; he wouldn't notice if the city fell.

REACT_CROWD_BYZ_LIGHTER.tr: [amazed] Cepte ateş! Rum ateşinin küçüğü mü bu? [eager] Surlara götür, işe yarar.
REACT_CROWD_BYZ_LIGHTER.en: [amazed] Fire in a pocket! A little Greek fire? [eager] Take it to the walls, it'll help.

REACT_CROWD_BYZ_PHONE.tr: [awed] [nervous] Bu parlak taş... içinde bir aziz mi var? [whispers] Haç çıkarayım en iyisi.
REACT_CROWD_BYZ_PHONE.en: [awed] [nervous] This shining stone... is there a saint inside? [whispers] I'd better cross myself.

REACT_CROWD_BYZ_SELFIE.tr: [suspicious] Bu sopayla ne yapacaksın? [amused] Balık mı tutacaksın, beni mi?
REACT_CROWD_BYZ_SELFIE.en: [suspicious] What are you going to do with that stick? [amused] Catch fish, or me?

REACT_CROWD_CAMP_ANY.tr: [shrugging] Frenk işi. [dismissive] Ben karışmam, çavuşa sor.
REACT_CROWD_CAMP_ANY.en: [shrugging] Frankish stuff. Not my business. [dismissive] Ask the sergeant.

REACT_CROWD_CAMP_CHICKPEAS.tr: [delighted] Leblebi! [eager] Ver bir avuç, sabaha kadar senin adamınım.
REACT_CROWD_CAMP_CHICKPEAS.en: [delighted] Chickpeas! [eager] Give me a handful and I'm your man till dawn.

REACT_CROWD_CAMP_COLOGNE.tr: [surprised] Kolonya mı? [laughs] Üç gündür yıkanmadım, dökebilirsin.
REACT_CROWD_CAMP_COLOGNE.en: [surprised] Cologne? I haven't washed in three days. [laughs] Go ahead.

REACT_CROWD_CAMP_CUBE.tr: [puzzled] Rengârenk zar mı? [skeptical] Bununla tavla oynanmaz ki.
REACT_CROWD_CAMP_CUBE.en: [puzzled] Coloured dice? [skeptical] You can't play backgammon with that.

REACT_CROWD_CAMP_LIGHTER.tr: [amazed] Çakmak kendi kendine yanıyor! [laughs] Urban görse topuna takar.
REACT_CROWD_CAMP_LIGHTER.en: [amazed] It lights itself! [laughs] If Urban sees it he'll bolt it onto his cannon.

REACT_CROWD_CAMP_PHONE.tr: [suspicious] Bu ne? İçinden ses geliyor. [nervous] Hocaya götür, okusun.
REACT_CROWD_CAMP_PHONE.en: [suspicious] What's this? There's a voice inside. [nervous] Take it to the imam, let him read over it.

REACT_CROWD_CAMP_SELFIE.tr: [nervous] [lowered voice] Sopanın ucunda ayna mı? Ağa görmesin, sihir der.
REACT_CROWD_CAMP_SELFIE.en: [nervous] [lowered voice] A mirror on a stick? Don't let the Agha see, he'll call it sorcery.

REACT_CROWD_GAL_ANY.tr: [shrewd] Her şeyin bir fiyatı var. [curious] Bununki kaç?
REACT_CROWD_GAL_ANY.en: [shrewd] Everything has a price. [curious] What's this one's?

REACT_CROWD_GAL_CHICKPEAS.tr: [intrigued] Leblebi mi? Cenova'da bununla zengin olunur. [eager] Ortak olalım.
REACT_CROWD_GAL_CHICKPEAS.en: [intrigued] Roasted chickpeas? In Genoa this would make a man rich. [eager] Let's be partners.

REACT_CROWD_GAL_COLOGNE.tr: [sniffs] [shrewd] Limon suyu mu, parfüm mü? Hangisiyse fiyatını ikiye katla.
REACT_CROWD_GAL_COLOGNE.en: [sniffs] [shrewd] Lemon water or perfume? Whichever it is, double the price.

REACT_CROWD_GAL_CUBE.tr: [delighted] Renkli bilmece! [scheming] Venediklilere satarım, bir yıl uğraşsınlar.
REACT_CROWD_GAL_CUBE.en: [delighted] A coloured puzzle! [scheming] I'll sell it to the Venetians and keep them busy for a year.

REACT_CROWD_GAL_LIGHTER.tr: [impressed] Ateşi cebinde taşıyan adam! [scheming] Bununla barut ticareti yaparız.
REACT_CROWD_GAL_LIGHTER.en: [impressed] A man who carries fire in his pocket! [scheming] We could do the powder trade with this.

REACT_CROWD_GAL_PHONE.tr: [curious] Bu ne? Kaç akçe? [haggling] Bin dukaya alırım. [quickly] Tamam, bin iki yüz.
REACT_CROWD_GAL_PHONE.en: [curious] What's this? [haggling] How much? I'll give you a thousand ducats. [quickly] Fine, twelve hundred.

REACT_CROWD_GAL_SELFIE.tr: [amused] Kendi resmini mi yapıyorsun? [teasing] Floransalılar ressam tutar, sen sopa tutuyorsun.
REACT_CROWD_GAL_SELFIE.en: [amused] Making your own portrait? Florentines hire a painter. [teasing] You hold a stick.

D30O_Z_01.tr: [commanding] Kâtip! Benim merdivenimi sen taşıyacaksın. [proud] Bak, sarayın ışıkları yanıyor. [determined] Sabaha o ışıkları biz yakacağız!
D30O_Z_01.en: [commanding] Clerk! You'll carry my ladder. [proud] The palace is there, its lights are on. [determined] By morning we'll be the ones lighting them.

D30O_Z_END.tr: [exhausted] [bitter] Bu gece olmadı. Bu sur bu gece bize geçit vermedi. [grim] Hünkâr'a arz edeceğim: saray tarafı merdivenle aşılmaz, çok yüksek.
D30O_Z_END.en: [exhausted] [bitter] Not tonight. This wall didn't fall tonight. [grim] I'll tell the Sultan: the palace side is too high.

D30O_Z_PLANT.en: [shouting] [commanding] Ladder to the wall! [urgent] Climb! [battle cry] Up!

D30O_Z_RETREAT.tr: [shouting] [urgent] Boru çaldı, geri! [desperate] Merdivenleri bırakın, yaralıları bırakmayın!
D30O_Z_RETREAT.en: [shouting] [urgent] The horn! Back! [desperate] Leave the ladders, don't leave the men!

D21O_Z_01.tr: [confident] Sultan surların üstünden geçemiyorsa [smirks] altından geçer. [commanding] Dragan, bu adam senin. [dismissive] Büro'nun kâtibiymiş; kâtip de kazar.
D21O_Z_01.en: [confident] If the Sultan can't go over the walls, [smirks] he goes under them. [commanding] Dragan, this man is yours. [dismissive] He's the Bureau's clerk, they say; clerks dig too.

D25_Z_1.tr: [scornful] Hangi donanma? Gözcüler bir yelken görmedi. [dismissive] Frenkler kendi aralarında bölük pörçük. [fierce] Surlar yıkılıyor, askerin yüreği sağlam.
D25_Z_1.en: [scornful] What fleet? The lookouts have not seen a single sail. [dismissive] The Franks are divided among themselves. [fierce] The walls are crumbling, the army's heart is strong.

D25_Z_2.tr: [firm] Ben de. [intense] Bugün dönersek yarın hiç gelmeyiz. [resolute] Hücum, Sultanım.
D25_Z_2.en: [firm] So am I. [intense] If we turn back today, we never come again. [resolute] The assault, my Sultan.

D27_Z_01.tr: [loud] [proclaiming] Galata'nın ileri gelenleri! Padişahımız, kapılarını açan Galata'ya ahitnamesini verdi. [commanding] Dinleyin.
D27_Z_01.en: [loud] [proclaiming] Notables of Galata! Our Sultan has granted his charter to Galata, which opened its gates. [commanding] Listen.

D27_Z_02.tr: [proclaiming] Evleriniz, dükkânlarınız, bağlarınız, gemileriniz ve mallarınız sizindir. [firm] Kadınlarınıza, çocuklarınıza kimse dokunmayacak.
D27_Z_02.en: [proclaiming] Your houses, shops, vineyards, ships and goods are yours. [firm] No one will touch your wives or your children.

D27_Z_03.tr: [proclaiming] Kiliseleriniz sizin kalır; [stern] yalnız çan çalınmayacak, yeni kilise yapılmayacak. [measured] Haracınızı verecek, ticaretinizi karada ve denizde serbestçe yapacaksınız.
D27_Z_03.en: [proclaiming] Your churches remain yours; [stern] only no bells will be rung and no new churches built. [measured] You will pay your tax and trade freely by land and sea.

D27_Z_04.tr: [proclaiming] Gidenler geri dönerse malları kendilerine verilecek. [measured] İşlerinizi görmek için aranızdan bir kethüda seçeceksiniz.
D27_Z_04.en: [proclaiming] Those who left will have their property returned if they come back. [measured] You will choose an elder from among yourselves to manage your affairs.

D27_Z_05.tr: [stern] Kara tarafındaki surlarınız yıkılacak, silahlarınız teslim edilecek. [calmer] Deniz tarafı kalsın; orası ticaretin kapısıdır.
D27_Z_05.en: [stern] Your walls on the landward side will be pulled down and your weapons handed over. [calmer] The sea side may stay; that is the gate of trade.

D33O_Z_01.tr: [impatient] Usta! Halil Paşa'nın kulesi bizden iki sıra önde. [threatening] Bu tepe ondan geri kalırsa sen de duyarsın, ben de.
D33O_Z_01.en: [impatient] Master! Halil Pasha's tower is two courses ahead of us. [threatening] If this hill falls behind his, you'll hear about it, and so will I.

D25_H_1.tr: [measured] [grave] Sultanım, elli gündür surların önündeyiz. [worried] Macar ordusu yolda, Venedik donanması denizde, derler. [pleading] Haraca razı olalım, dönelim.
D25_H_1.en: [measured] [grave] My Sultan, we have been before these walls for fifty days. [worried] They say a Hungarian army is on the road and a Venetian fleet at sea. [pleading] Let us accept tribute and go home.

D25_H_2.tr: [grave] Sultanım, bir yenilgi yıllarca kazanılanı götürür. [quietly] Ben devletin yarınını düşünüyorum.
D25_H_2.en: [grave] My Sultan, one defeat can take away the gains of years. [quietly] I am thinking of the state's tomorrow.
